Cross-ref Al Jazeera (aljazeera-ninth-night.txt) for Rubio verbatim.
Retrieved 2026-07-20 via Exa.

Rubio, speaking before departing for ASEAN foreign ministers' meeting in the Philippines, accused Iran of trying to use the Strait of Hormuz as "leverage against the world" and said US remains open to diplomacy but "it has to be real." Urged other countries to "step up" and share responsibility for protecting shipping — "whether it's hardware or finances." (Verbatim per Al Jazeera: US "will do and continue to do what it needs to, to protect global shipping, but other countries need to begin to step up.")

Iran International: US intensified campaign after first confirmed American combat deaths; Rubio's stance echoes VP JD Vance's earlier argument that military pressure and diplomacy proceed together. Iran's chief negotiator / parliament speaker Mohammad-Bagher Ghalibaf similarly described war and negotiations as complementary. Iranian FM says negotiations should begin only when Tehran has secured "the upper hand" militarily. Both sides appear to be strengthening bargaining positions rather than abandoning diplomacy; ceasefire period (60-day MoU signed mid-June) now acknowledged by both sides as effectively collapsed (Trump declared it "over" on 8 July).

Guardian live blog: a vessel caught fire in the Strait of Hormuz early Monday off the coast of Oman (British military reported the fire), along a route the US had encouraged commercial vessels to use; IRGC later claimed it targeted tankers transiting the strait.
